compare.notEvidence: A difference alone is not evidence of a meaningful effect. Output also changes for reasons unrelated to what you are comparing.
compare.notIdentical: Identical settings do not guarantee identical results: a model file, runtime variant or background load can still change the output.
compare.notRun: Not run: stopped before this model started.
compare.scope: Both runs use this node and its current llama.cpp build, one after the other. Timings of a run can include loading its model.
compare.waiting: Waiting for the first run to finish.
